item.title: Michigan brokerage Good Company joins Real through private label program - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: Detroit-area brokerage Good Company has joined Real Brokerage through its private label program, bringing 172 agents to the platform and strengthening Real’s footprint across southeast Michigan.

item.title: Commercial and multifamily mortgage debt rises $53.4bn in Q3 2025 - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: Commercial and multifamily mortgage debt outstanding climbed to $4.93trn in the third quarter of 2025, driven by continued growth in multifamily lending, according to the Mortgage Bankers Association.

item.title: Newrez to allow crypto assets to be used for mortgage qualification - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: Newrez will become the first top-25 US mortgage lender to recognise eligible crypto assets for mortgage qualification, allowing borrowers to use digital holdings without liquidating them.

item.title: Realfinity and Homa partner to offer sub-market mortgage rates for buyers - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: Realfinity and Homa have launched a partnership giving eligible homebuyers access to mortgage rates 0.75% below the national average through an embedded, AI-driven financing model.

item.title: US monthly housing payments fall to near two-year low as mortgage rates drop - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: The median US monthly housing payment fell 5.5% year over year to $2,413 in early January, driven by a sharp decline in mortgage rates, according to Redfin.

item.title: 30-year fixed mortgage rate falls to 6.06%, Freddie Mac says - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: The average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage dropped to its lowest level in more than three years, boosting purchase and refinance activity, according to Freddie Mac.

item.title: Existing-home sales rise 5.1% in December as market shows late-year lift - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: Existing-home sales climbed to their strongest seasonally adjusted pace in nearly three years as mortgage rates eased and price growth slowed, according to the National Association of Realtors.

item.title: New home mortgage applications rise year on year despite December slowdown - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: Mortgage applications for newly built homes were 2.5% higher than a year earlier in December, even as activity eased from November, according to the Mortgage Bankers Association.

item.title: US asking rents fall for 29th straight month as pressure eases at top end of market - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: The national median asking rent slipped 0.7% year over year in December, extending a nearly two-and-a-half-year run of annual declines, according to new data.

item.title: Single-family rent growth slows to weakest pace in more than 15 years - The Funding Line - Latest U.S. property finance news
item.description: Annual single-family rent growth eased to 1.1% in November, marking the slowest pace in over a decade as the rental market continues to cool, according to Cotality.
